files.what_it_shows: Figure 1-1 at 1 to 60,000 for Northern Natural Gas. The proposed pipeline (red dashes) runs from the new Hobbs compressor station north of US 62 in Lea County, New Mexico, southeast past the Lea County Regional Airport and Hobbs, then east along Monument Highway across the New Mexico and Texas state line to the Gaines County Generating Station in Gaines County, Texas. The Plains recycle valve site in Yoakum County, Texas, is shown in an inset because it is about 29 miles northeast of the main route. A small locator inset shows Denver City, Texas.

notes: The map is clear and shows the main pipeline and the Plains recycle valve site. The sheet says 16.2 miles from New Mexico to Texas. The application says 15.1 miles of 24 inch pipe plus 1.1 miles of 16 inch pipe, which adds to 16.2 miles, in Lea County, New Mexico and Gaines County, Texas. Only about 14.5 miles are in New Mexico and the rest is in Texas, per the application text. The legend shows the proposed pipeline in red dashes and existing pipelines in black dashes, so a georeferencer must follow the red line only. The route also includes a short 16 inch segment near the Transwestern-Lea County interconnect, and the application also has a separate Segment 2 near the Hobbs-Plains launcher, so not every mapped line is part of the 16.2 miles. The FERC download page is a JavaScript application, so the URL checker calls it a JavaScript shell; the file itself was downloaded and read directly.
